description: Public free Search Repair Radar teaser. Preview only — never unlocks the $29/mo paid repair packet. Owned product properties that already declare Search Console on their adapter use that bind (no access_token). Other sites need a Google access_token or return needs_auth + human connect URL. Rate-limited.

access_token.description: Optional. OAuth access token with webmasters.readonly for sites that are not an owned adapter property. Not required for an already-bound product GSC property.

gsc_site_url.description: GSC property e.g. sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/

notify_email.description: Optional. If you want a link back to this report later, send an email. Not required.

name: launchfiles_standalone_search_repair_radar_free
